newsitem.title: UK: JWT Europe ad agency expands into Ukraine.
newsitem.headline: JWT Europe ad agency expands into Ukraine.

text.p: JWT Europe, part of the WPP Group Plc's J. Walter Thompson advertising agency, on Friday said it is expanding into Ukraine via an agreement with Ark Communications.

JWT said it formed an affiliation with Ark Communications in Kiev, with the possibility of gaining equity in the operation later this year. JWT and Ark are already involved jointly in ventures in Moscow and the Czech Republic in which JWT holds equity stakes.

Ark Communications Ukraine, founded in 1994, ranked as the country's number one agency in 1996 with billing of about $6 million. The agency will be run by Thomas Knapek, who moves to Kiev from Ark/JWT in Prague.
The agency's clients include Ferrero, Unilever, Kraft Jacobs Suchard and Warenr Lambert.
